entries.title: Change tracking file deletion failed
entries.description: EIMS detects a change tracking deletion failure. Missing, corrupt or locked CTK data are possibilities requiring evidence, not established causes.
observed_signatures: Could not delete change tracking file
investigation_steps: Preserve the exact CTK error and operation context.
Check file existence and explicit lock evidence before considering remediation.
entries.compatibility_scope: Existing tested CTK deletion signature; official lock article not generalized.
entries.limitations: Reference knowledge is not proof of root cause. Existing tested CTK deletion signature; official lock article not generalized.

entries.title: Snapshot configuration / required-file failure
entries.description: EIMS detects invalid snapshot format with a required-file failure. The missing filename and operation must come from evidence.
observed_signatures: A required file was not found
investigation_steps: Determine whether the failure occurred during creation, deletion or revert.
Verify referenced files without deleting or moving snapshot data.

Collect complete Veeam job logs and matching VMware operation evidence.
entries.compatibility_scope: Existing replica signatures; operation-specific VMware gates retained.
